Interface Connection.Changing

All Superinterfaces:
ChangeHolder<Connection.Writable, Connection.Changing>, ChangeHolder.Child<Connection.Writable, Connection.Changing>, CommandSource, Connection<Connection.Writable>, Connection.Writable, DataHolder<Connection.Writable>, DataHolder.Mutable<Connection.Writable>
Enclosing interface:
Connection<Self extends Connection<Self>>
public static interface Connection.Changing extends Connection.Writable, ChangeHolder.Child<Connection.Writable, Connection.Changing>
A ChangeHolder.Child version of the connection. Therefore, any changes made on this instance will not apply until the ChangeHolder.Child.commitDirectChanges() is called
